messages:
Priya: Console dry-run estimate for backfill job `job_2026_03_21` shows ~2.3M tokens / ~1.2h but API dry-run returns ~3.9M tokens / ~2.1h. Anyone seen this mismatch before? :thinking:
Leo: Can you paste the exact command you used for the API dry-run? Also screenshot of console estimate if possible.
Priya: I used the console -> Reprocess preview button. For API: `curl -s -X POST "https://console.internal/reprocess/dry-run" -d '{"job_id":"job_2026_03_21"}' | jq .`
Jamie: Possible culprit: console preview applies the console routing policy (burst + prefix-cache) while the API dry-run uses default routing (conservative, no burst). They use different estimator codepaths historically.
Eli: Found logs for the job — console called estimator_v2, api dry-run hit estimator_v1. log snippet: ```
INFO estimator_v1: batch_size=1, kv_cache_hit_ratio=0.04
INFO estimator_v2: batch_size=4, kv_cache_hit_ratio=0.32
```
Ana: That explains token delta. v2 assumes more batching and better prefix cache reuse -> fewer effective tokens. We should either unify estimators or surface which one is used in UI.
Priya: UX ask: can we show the estimator version and routing policy on the preview card and add a small tooltip: "estimator mismatch may affect time/cost"? Right now it's opaque.
Jamie: Short-term workaround: expose the API query params used by console in the preview (routing_policy, batch_hint, estimator=v2). Example curl to replicate console behavior: ```
curl -X POST 'https://api.internal/reprocess/dry-run' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"job_id":"job_2026_03_21","routing_policy":"burst_friendly","estimator":"v2"}' | jq .
```
Leo: I'll open an issue with steps to reproduce + compare table. tagging eng-platform and devex. Issue will propose: (1) surface policy+estimator in UI, (2) make console preview call a canonical dry-run endpoint with explicit params, (3) eventually converge estimator code.
deploy-bot: deploy-k8s:rolling: estimator-service v2 -> canary on namespace reprocess-preview (2 pods) :rocket:
Eli: After canary, I re-ran the API dry-run with estimator=v2 and numbers match within 3%. So convergence fixes the discrepancy.
Ana: Longer-term: update console to run a quick validation check — if API estimate differs >10% from preview, show warning and an explanation of which param differs. Saves ops confusion.
Priya: Perfect. Leo — assign the issue back to me for the console change once it's created, I'll do the UI bits.
Leo: Issue 6782 opened: "console: surface reprocess estimator + routing policy + warning on diff". Added repro, logs, and suggested UX copy.
Priya: Thanks team. I'll shepherd the PR for the tooltip and warning. If anyone wants to help with tests for estimator parity, ping me. :thumbsup:
